en: Grunt
Hey! This is a private ship! Off you go, back down the gangway!
{rival}
{player}! You came! This ship's freezing... why is it so cold up on deck?
Cheren
It's dressed up as a cargo ship, but look at the crew. This is Team Plasma's ship, all right.
Grunt
Team Plasma? Correct answer! And there are a lot more of us here than there are of you!
{rival}
Then just tell us where you're keeping the Pokémon you've stolen! My sister's Purrloin first!
Grunt
Ha! Beat us first. And you, the quiet one, you're up first!
Grunt
Next! Somebody, next!
Grunt
My turn! You won't get past me so easy!
Grunt
What kind of Trainer is this?! Fall back, fall back!
Cheren
Good work. The way to the bow is open. Let's see who's giving the orders on this ship.
Zinzolin
Oh, my. The Gym Leader and a pair of children. Once again, we are made to feel unwelcome.
No matter. This ship will soon cover all of Unova in ice. The Shadow Triad will see you off.
Shadow Triad
By order of Lord Ghetsis, you leave this ship. Now.
There is a rush of wind, and the deck is gone from under your feet...
